biggest_catch: Rewards are per survey with frequent screen-outs — you can spend 10 minutes on screening questions and earn nothing — so there are no guaranteed surveys and the effective hourly rate is low; the $3 cashout is real but reaching it takes many attempts.
catches: Screen-outs are common: you can be disqualified mid-survey and earn only a tiny consolation (or nothing), which is normal for every survey app.
Pay per survey is small (third-party testing reports roughly $0.10-$3 per survey; exact amount is shown in-app before you start).
Survey availability and cashout thresholds vary by country (app operates in ~70 countries); ~$3 PayPal / ~$2.50 Revolut/gift-card minimums are US/UK figures.
Mobile app only (iOS/Android) — no desktop version.
AttaPoll's official public pages do not publish a minimum age or a fixed per-survey rate table; those live inside the app.

steps: Download the official AttaPoll app (iOS App Store or Google Play) and create a free account.
Complete your profile honestly — better-matched demographics mean fewer screen-outs.
Browse available surveys; each shows the exact cash reward and time estimate before you start (skip low-paying ones).
Complete surveys; earnings are credited in real cash (no points conversion).
Once your balance reaches the cashout minimum shown in your app (~$3 for PayPal in the US), withdraw via PayPal, Revolut, or gift cards.
timing: PayPal payouts typically arrive within minutes; up to 72 hours if verification is required.
